scope: the AWS facts the curated SideFX AWS cloud-operations features rest on; 'search' marks facts confirmed through an AWS-docs search summary rather than a full page read

sources.title: CloudWatch alarm events and EventBridge
sources.facts: Alarm State Change envelope (id, account, region, resources, detail.state/previousState); states OK, ALARM, INSUFFICIENT_DATA; delivery to EventBridge is guaranteed

sources.title: CloudWatch MetricDataResult
sources.facts: Timestamps and Values pair one to one; StatusCode Complete, InternalError, PartialData, Forbidden

sources.title: EventBridge retry policy
sources.facts: retries for 24 hours and up to 185 times by default; after that the event is dropped unless a dead-letter queue is set

sources.title: EventBridge dead-letter queues
sources.facts: undelivered events go to the target's DLQ (named AWS-SEC-01 in the candidate pack)

sources.title: EventBridge API destinations
sources.facts: connections carry the authorization (credentials kept in Secrets Manager); 5 second timeout; 401, 407, 409, 429 and 5xx are retried

sources.title: AWS Config multi-account, multi-Region aggregation
sources.facts: an aggregator collects configuration data from source accounts and Regions, read only

sources.title: Config GetAggregateResourceConfig
sources.facts: one configuration item for a SourceAccountId and SourceRegion; ResourceNotDiscoveredException when unknown or not discovered; no deleted resources

sources.title: Config ConfigurationItem
sources.facts: configurationItemStatus OK, ResourceDiscovered, ResourceNotRecorded, ResourceDeleted, ResourceDeletedNotRecorded; configuration is a JSON string; recordingFrequency DAILY when daily

sources.title: AWS Organizations integration with AWS Config
sources.facts: organization-wide aggregation

sources.title: Cross-account resource access in IAM
sources.facts: cross-account roles

sources.title: STS AssumeRole
sources.facts: sessions of 900 to 43200 seconds (1 hour when chaining roles); the caller must be trusted by the role and allowed sts:AssumeRole

sources.title: CloudTrail event history
sources.facts: 90 days of management events per Region; no data, Insights or network activity events; one account, one Region, one attribute; no organization aggregation

sources.title: CloudTrail LookupEvents
sources.facts: 2 requests per second per account per Region; at most 50 events a page; Resources named by ResourceType and ResourceName; EventTime is a timestamp

sources.title: EC2 DescribeInstanceStatus
sources.facts: only running instances unless IncludeAllInstances; state names and codes (stopped 80, running 16)

sources.title: EC2 InstanceStatusSummary
sources.facts: status ok, impaired, insufficient-data, not-applicable, initializing

sources.title: Systems Manager StartAutomationExecution
sources.facts: ClientToken is a UUID that can't be reused; IdempotentParameterMismatch on a retry with other parameters; the answer is only AutomationExecutionId

sources.title: Run an automation that requires approvals
sources.facts: AWS-StartEC2InstanceWithApproval takes InstanceId, Approvers and SNSTopicArn; the approval request is valid for 7 days

sources.title: Systems Manager AutomationExecution
sources.facts: AutomationExecutionStatus values (Waiting, Success, Failed, TimedOut, Cancelled and the rest); there is no WaitingForApproval

sources.title: aws:approve
sources.facts: the automation shows Waiting until approvers decide; ApprovalStatus Approved, Rejected, Waiting; up to 10 approvers (users or roles); 7 day default timeout

sources.title: Systems Manager SendAutomationSignal
sources.facts: SignalType Approve, Reject, StartStep, StopStep, Resume, Revoke

sources.title: Automation runbook reference: Amazon EC2
sources.facts: AWS-StartEC2Instance, AWS-StopEC2Instance, AWS-RestartEC2Instance are listed; the WithApproval runbooks are not on this page

sources.title: CloudWatch Application Signals SLOs
sources.facts: service level objectives over Application Signals (optional enrichment)

sources.title: Application Signals ServiceLevelObjectiveBudgetReport
sources.facts: BudgetStatus OK, WARNING, BREACHED, INSUFFICIENT_DATA

sources.title: CloudFormation change sets
sources.facts: a change set previews a change; nothing changes until it is executed

sources.title: CloudFormation DescribeChangeSet
sources.facts: Status CREATE_COMPLETE and the rest; ExecutionStatus AVAILABLE means it can still be executed

sources.title: Security Hub EventBridge event types
sources.facts: Findings Imported V2, one finding per event; Security Hub and Security Hub CSPM both use source aws.securityhub, so rules must match the Security Hub detail-type

sources.title: Security Hub EventBridge event formats
sources.facts: detail.findings holds the OCSF finding

sources.title: Security Hub OcsfFindingIdentifier
sources.facts: cloud.account.uid + finding_info.uid + metadata.product.uid identify a finding; metadata.uid is globally unique; severity_id 0-6 or 99

sources.title: Cost Explorer API
sources.facts: programmatic cost and usage

sources.title: Cost Explorer GetCostAndUsage
sources.facts: Start inclusive, End exclusive; Estimated marks an unfinalized period; amounts are strings with a Unit; tag groups are key$value, untagged spend key$

sources.title: AWS Backup restore testing
sources.facts: scheduled restore jobs of type Test, their completion time and optional validation; restored resources are deleted afterwards (the candidate pack pointed this ID at the SSM runbook guide)

sources.title: AWS Backup RestoreJobsListMember
sources.facts: Status PENDING, RUNNING, COMPLETED, ABORTED, FAILED; ValidationStatus; DeletionStatus; CreationDate and CompletionDate

sources.title: AWS Backup feature availability
sources.facts: continuous backup and point-in-time restore cover Aurora, RDS, SAP HANA on EC2 and S3, not EC2 instances
